lines.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the Colossians all the news and to encourage their hearts.
Aristarchus, Mark the cousin of Barnabas, and Justus send greetings, and the Colossians should welcome Mark if he comes.
Epaphras, one of the Colossians, wrestles in prayer for them and goes to great pains for Laodicea, Hierapolis, and Philippi.

wrong_details.true: Colossae, Laodicea and Hierapolis (the three towns are Colossae, Laodicea, Hierapolis)

lines.text: Luke the physician and Demas send greetings, and Paul tells the Colossians to have this letter read in Ephesus after them.
Paul tells Archippus to complete his ministry, then writes a greeting in his own hand, asking them to remember his chains.
